flowchart
N1 start "Start"
N2 io "Input a, b, c"
N3 dec "a >= b AND a >= c?"
N4 io "Display "a is largest""
N5 end "End"
N6 dec "b >= a AND b >= c?"
N7 io "Display "b is largest""
N8 end "End"
N9 io "Display "c is largest""
N10 end "End"
E N1 N2
E N2 N3
E N3 N4 "Yes"
E N3 N6 "No"
E N4 N5
E N6 N7 "Yes"
E N6 N9 "No"
E N7 N8
E N9 N10
